english.title: Riding pedal cycle under the influence of drink or drugs
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) rode a cycle on a

(A)_[road,]_
(B)_[public place,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE ROAD AND LOCATION OR PUBLIC PLACE..), whilst unfit to ride through drink or drugs.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 30 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

date and location
rode a pedal cycle on road/public place
